purpose: Machine-readable source registry for VIN, chassis, and OEM lookup routing.

free_baseline: NHTSA vPIC API for basic VIN/WMI decode, WMI decode, and batch VIN decode
local WMI/platform hints for common AutoStop ROW/JDM patterns
CRM vehicle_profile context with explicit conflict reporting
high_confidence_requires: VIN/frame-specific EPC or commercial catalog confirmation
production date/build window and market/grade/options when parts are VIN-critical
independent source or supplier confirmation before CRM parts writeback

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC API
sources.notes: Primary VIN decode source for regulated vehicles. Supports decode and manufacturer data.

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC Home
sources.notes: Official home for VIN decoding, MID, and downloadable standalone datasets.

sources.name: Toyota Japan EPC Help
sources.notes: Documents Toyota Japan catalog inputs including VIN and frame number search flow.

sources.name: Toyota Recall Search
sources.notes: Useful for Japan-market chassis-number confirmation.

sources.name: Honda EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Honda catalog mirror with frame-number search entry and catalog navigation.

sources.name: Honda Recall Lookup
sources.notes: Recall lookup only, but useful as a source-of-truth check when Honda VIN routing is needed.

sources.name: Nissan EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Nissan catalog mirror with frame-number search entry and catalog navigation.

sources.name: Nissan Recall Search
sources.notes: Official Japanese recall lookup that accepts chassis or vehicle-number style searches.

sources.name: Mazda Recall Search
sources.notes: Official Mazda recall lookup for Japan-market confirmation.

sources.name: Subaru Recall Search
sources.notes: Official Subaru recall lookup for Japan-market confirmation.

sources.name: Subaru EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Subaru catalog mirror with frame-number search entry and catalog navigation.

sources.name: partslink24 Mobile
sources.notes: VIN-scan entry and genuine parts access for participating brands; useful when dealership-grade catalog access is available.

sources.name: partslink24 Product Info
sources.notes: Explains VIN access and original parts access for authorized dealers.

sources.name: BMW AIR/ETK via AOS
sources.role: Authorized BMW/MINI route for VIN-specific vehicle identity, equipment, OEM catalog part numbers, and service information.
sources.access: Paid authorized AOS login; credentials and contract must stay outside Git.
sources.limits: Use only with authorized access. Treat output as high-confidence catalog evidence, but keep source/date in CRM notes.
sources.notes: Preferred BMW/MINI confirmation route when OEM numbers are VIN-critical.

sources.name: Volkswagen Group ETKA
sources.role: Authorized Volkswagen Group EPC route for VIN/PR-code-specific OEM part verification.
sources.access: Paid authorized ETKA or partslink24 access; credentials and screenshots must stay outside Git unless redacted.
sources.limits: VIN, PR codes, gearbox/engine codes, and production date are required before confirming DSG mechatronic or other configuration-sensitive parts.
sources.notes: Preferred VAG route for DSG, gearbox, electronics, and other PR-code-sensitive catalog decisions.

sources.name: Toyota EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Toyota catalog mirror with frame-number search entry.

sources.name: Hyundai EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Hyundai catalog mirror with VIN search entry.

sources.name: Kia EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Kia catalog mirror with VIN search entry.

sources.name: Renault EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Renault catalog mirror with model and VIN-oriented catalog navigation.

sources.name: Parts-Catalogs API
sources.role: VIN/FRAME entry into OEM catalogs and catalog group/part lookup.
sources.access: paid subscription/API access through Tradesoft/Parts-Catalogs; confirm contract and API auth before integration.
sources.limits: Commercial catalog; requires subscription; exact brand coverage and Russian/Krasnoyarsk pricing must be tested separately.
sources.notes: Primary candidate for OEM lookup when the task starts from CRM VIN/frame and a requested part group.

sources.name: PARTSAPI.RU
sources.role: VIN/OE decode, TecDoc-style catalog, applicability, crosses, CROSSBASE-style analogs, and part metadata.
sources.access: API key from PARTSAPI account; demo keys may be available in cabinet.
sources.limits: Not a закупка source by itself unless connected price/stock data is explicitly available; validate license and regional data freshness.
test_vin_checks: VINdecodeOE result for common Toyota/Kia/Hyundai VIN
getPartsbyVIN filtered by service part group
sources.notes: Good MVP candidate for cross/applicability layer after OEM candidate is found.

sources.name: 17VIN API
sources.role: VIN decoding and VIN-based OE parts/category lookup, including common-wear parts by VIN.
sources.access: Commercial API account/token; test account required.
sources.limits: China-hosted commercial API; confirm supported brands/markets, latency, terms, and data language before relying on it for Russian workflow.
sources.notes: Useful second-source candidate and high-coverage common parts route if contract is acceptable.

sources.name: AUTOPOISK
sources.role: Professional EPC, VIN/frame identification, OEM/Cross tab, supplier statistics, and repair information under subscription.
sources.access: Legal-entity subscription/demo; RESTful API is advertised for aftermarket data, terms required.
sources.limits: Works only for business users; demo access may hide spare part numbers; not a procurement source unless supplier price data is connected and current.
sources.notes: Strong manual/semiautomatic candidate for professional catalog verification and market context.

sources.name: PartSouq manual catalog
sources.role: Manual fallback for genuine catalog lookup, part diagrams, availability, and international price sanity check.
sources.access: Public website/account; manual verification only unless a contract/API is later confirmed.
sources.limits: International availability/price is not Russian procurement; coverage can be inconsistent; use as fallback/source check, not final закупка.
sources.notes: Keep as manual fallback and visual sanity check.

sources.name: epc-data manual catalog
sources.role: Manual fallback for Japanese frame-number and selected Korean VIN catalog entry.
sources.limits: Public mirror, not official; must be cross-checked before high-confidence CRM writeback.
sources.notes: Useful JDM/KDM fallback because it explicitly exposes frame/VIN entry patterns.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: read-only vehicle_info, groups, parts, diagrams; no CRM writes inside adapter.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Given one ISO VIN and one JDM frame, return exact vehicle profile and requested service-part OEM candidates with production/option evidence.
For each test OEM, return applicability, crosses, and confidence flags without treating crosses as fitment-confirmed by default.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Second-source VIN-to-parts and common-wear parts candidate.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: read-only VIN category/part search and replacement normalizer.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Find plugs/pads/filters by VIN and expose replacement chain/source provenance.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Manual/semiautomatic professional EPC, Cross tab, and supplier-statistics candidate.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: manual workflow first; API only after legal-entity subscription/demo confirms access.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Show exact vehicle equipment and OEM/cross evidence for test VIN/frame without storing raw customer identifiers.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Fallback/manual verification and international price sanity check.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Use as second check for part diagram/OEM only; never mark as Russian закупка.
For Japan/Korea test identifiers, confirm catalog entry and require second source before high confidence.
